texts.facts: Opposite party no.5 has been wrongly impleaded and therefore, stands deleted. 3. Petition has been filed challenging order dated 30.06.2018 whereby petitioner has been visited with the punishment of withholding of increment with cumulative effect. Also under challenge is the order dated 30.04.2019 whereby his revision against punishment order has been rejected.
texts.arguments: 4. It has been submitted that a bare perusal of the impugned order will make it evident that the same has been passed only on the basis of a complaint which was received by the officials concerned whereafter inspection took place on 01.03.2018 and holding petitioner guilty of dereliction of duty, the impugned punishment order has been passed without following procedure indicated in Rule-7 of the U.P. Government Servant (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1999. 5. It is submitted that withholding of increment with cumulative effect clearly comes within scope of major penalty has defined under Rule 3 of the Rules of 1999 and therefore, it was incumbent upon the opposite parties to have followed the mandatory procedure required in terms of Rule 7 of the Rules of 1999. 6. Learned State Counsel has refuted submissions advanced by learned counsel for petitioner and relying upon the counter affidavit filed, submits that a complaint was received against a businessman, in pursuance of which a raid was conducted by a team of Food Safety Officers on 01.03.2018 with seizing of samples. It is submitted that in pursuance thereof, show cause notice was issued to petitioner on 06.06.2018 to which a reply was also submitted and therefore, it cannot be said that petitioner was not provided any opportunity of hearing. It is submitted that it is in fact upon consideration of reply submitted that the impugned punishment order has been passed.
